240-5223-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

4279-5075-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-4091-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-4616-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4616-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

240-728-4359-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-2438-3125-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-5632.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

851-1308-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4094-5658-6245-7824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
4094-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

215-1526-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-6965.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-4478-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4478-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

560-2457-4289-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-2366-5003-7705.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Minion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2921-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
2921-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1115-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

1484-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6273-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5231-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5231-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3259-5659-6968.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5659-6968.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

341-3532-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
341-3532-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1365-2608-5256-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2608-5256-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-3875-5552-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-3875-5552-6664.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

983-1987-2468-3094.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-1987-2468-3094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Temple of the False God and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

719-1283-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2829-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2829-5361-5365.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
2829-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2167-3585-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-3585-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1418-1887-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1418-1887-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2281-2757-3967-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2757-3967-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

3259-3709-4478.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3709-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Rabble Rousing triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Human Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1467-2104-2499-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2104-2499-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1467-2103-3634-4568.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2103-3634-4568.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

661-1874-5118.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
661-1874-5118.notablePrerequisites:
Rescue Racer.
Ratchet is your commander.
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
661-1874-5118.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Ratchet, Rescue Racer.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Sculpting Steel triggers, failing to convert it.
Cast Ratchet from the command zone as Ratchet, Field Medic by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain one life.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, converting itself.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6.

864-1895-2562-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1082-1393-1479.description:
Cast Aether Channeler by paying {2}{U}.
Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Dual Nature's first ability, and Kodama.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, choosing any of its modes.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Aether Channeler.
The token Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Kodama.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, returning the nontoken Aether Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Aether Channeler leaves the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's second ability, exiling all tokens named Aether Channeler.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Aether Channeler from your hand onto the battlefield.
Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature.
Repeat from step 4.

1017-1143-3062-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Diviner's Wand attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
1017-1143-3062-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card.
Cryptic Trilobite and Wizard Class trigger.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Wizard Class trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-1637-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight lands.
You control at least five basic lands, two of which must be Forests.
You have at least one card in hand.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1401-1637-5033.description:
Activate all basic lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{G}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the basic lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding a card to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
The lands enter the battlefield, triggering Aesi that many times, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.

1030-3525-4050-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-3525-4050-4840.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {1}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Myr tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

2816-3430-4360.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Greenweaver Druid.
Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3430-4360.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding six {G}.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

224-872-4300.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-872-4300.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

2178-5250.notablePrerequisites:
Merieke Ri Berit does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Merieke Ri Berit.
You have a way to untap Merieke Ri Berit once.
2178-5250.description:
Activate Merieke Ri Berit's own ability by tapping it, gaining control of target creature as long as you control Merieke Ri Berit and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Untap Merieke Ri Berit by any method.
Merieke Ri Berit's delayed triggered ability triggers, destroying the creature you gained control of.
Merieke Ri Berit's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers.
In response, activate Merieke Ri Berit's own ability by tapping it, gaining control of target creature as long as you control Merieke Ri Berit and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve the ability from step 4, untapping Merieke Ri Berit.
Repeat from step 3.
